No photo shows this; it requires a screenshot of the system storage or a video of the console booting to a game.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and a clear shot of the HDMI port.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or a screenshot of a controller test utility.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'System Information' screen showing the console's serial number and online status.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powering on and navigating the system menu.
Screenshot of the system storage showing the number of games installed.
Video of the controller being used to navigate menus.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
